stories.source: follow-up from Phase 2 screens and reports
stories.notes: Re-check sampler job with independent-volunteer tasks; per-SIM adult cap test added.

stories.title: Enforce the audit-metadata rule (no phone numbers, PINs or response contents) with a scrubber and a test
stories.source: follow-up from Phase 2 screens and reports
stories.notes: Audit scrubber redacts sensitive keys and phone-shaped values at write time; cannot catch a PIN written inside free prose.

stories.title: Dual-hash phone lookup in identity so phone-key rotation can run online
stories.source: follow-up from Phase 2 screens and reports
stories.notes: Dual-hash phone lookup for online key rotation. Household invites made before a rotation may need re-issuing; numbers whose encrypted copy was purged cannot be rehashed.

stories.title: Use number-intelligence risk/trust in identity decisions (quality, caps)
stories.source: follow-up from Phase 2 screens and reports
stories.notes: Number-intelligence risk lowers OTP caps and selects the low survey key class; vendor failure never blocks sign-up; recycled numbers are flagged restricted (no extra OTP step).

stories.title: Break-glass admin API with dual control and audit
stories.source: follow-up from Phase 2 screens and reports
stories.notes: Break-glass admin API with two-other-admin approval and one-time wrapped export; requests are in memory so a restart cancels them.

stories.title: Honest SMS state when the vendor is down (queued/failed, not just code sent)
stories.source: follow-up from Phase 2 screens and reports
stories.notes: OTP responses say sent/queued/failed; failed sends drop the code so a resend works at once.
